en.headline: Little Bao chef May Chow to cook at Regent Lobby Lounge in October
en.dek: The hotel says the month-long residency runs from 2 to 31 October at The Lobby Lounge on Salisbury Road, pairing bao and sharing plates with the harbour view.
body: Regent Hong Kong said chef May Chow, founder of Little Bao, will hold a month-long residency at The Lobby Lounge from 2 to 31 October, working with the hotel's executive chef Calvin Choi.

The hotel's announcement lists six dishes that recast familiar Hong Kong flavours as baos and snacks, including Chiu Chow seaweed poppers, "beef noodle" fries, a salt-and-pepper kuruma prawn bao, a satay beef short-rib bao, a plant-based char siu bao and a put chai ko ice-cream bao. The lounge sits on the lobby floor at 18 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, facing Victoria Harbour.

The Lobby Lounge is open from 10am to midnight; dinner service runs from 6pm. The hotel said tables can be reserved through its restaurant booking page or by calling 2313 2313. Prices for the collaboration menu were not listed in the announcement.

zh.headline: 包點店Little Bao主廚周思薇月進駐香港麗晶酒店
zh.dek: 酒店宣布10月2日至31日於大堂酒廊與行政總廚Calvin Choi合作，以包點及分享小食重塑本地街頭味道，面向維港。
body: 香港麗晶酒店宣布，包點店Little Bao創辦人兼主廚周思薇將於10月2日至31日在大堂酒廊駐場，與酒店行政總廚Calvin Choi合作推出限定菜單。
酒店公布的菜式包括潮式紫菜脆口、乾炒牛河味薯條、椒鹽車蝦包、沙喱牛仔骨包、素叉燒包，以及砢仔糕雪糕包。大堂酒廊位於尖沙咎梵士巴利道18號酒店大堂層，面向維多利亞港。
酒廊開放時間為上午10時至午夜，晚餐由下午6時起。酒店表示可經網上訂座或致電2313 2313預約。合作菜單價錢未有在公布中列出。
